source.name: CMS Provider Data Catalog — Home Health Care Agencies
source.license: Public domain — U.S. federal government data, no authentication required

column_mapping.dba_name: NOT IN SOURCE — CMS HHA dataset does not publish DBA names; column included but empty
column_mapping.zip_code: ZIP Code (left-padded to 5 digits; ZIP+4 suffix dropped)
column_mapping.ownership_type: Type of Ownership (CMS dash sentinel normalized to empty string)
column_mapping.agency_type: Derived: all records in dataset 6jpm-sxkc are Home Health agencies
column_mapping.medicare_participation_status: Derived: only Medicare-certified agencies are published in this dataset — all set to 'Participating'
column_mapping.overall_quality_star_rating: Quality of patient care star rating (CMS dash sentinel normalized to empty string)
column_mapping.medicare_certification_date: Certification Date — date agency was first certified by Medicare
column_mapping.date_of_most_recent_inspection: NOT IN SOURCE — CMS does not publish HHA inspection/survey dates in this dataset; column included but empty
column_mapping.source_url: Static CMS dataset page URL on every row

quality_notes: 2,037 rows had ownership_type = '-' (CMS not-available sentinel); normalized to empty string
4,431 rows (35.8%) have no star rating — these are newly certified or low-volume agencies per CMS methodology
dba_name and date_of_most_recent_inspection are empty for all rows — fields not published by CMS in this dataset
phone formatting applied: 10-digit to (NXX) NXX-XXXX; 1-prefixed 11-digit also handled
ZIP codes left-padded to 5 digits to restore leading zeros dropped by spreadsheet tools
